skips.reason: precondition not met: a support with a spring

changeRecord.title: support spring stiffness changed
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A spring support shares load with the structure in proportion to stiffness. A spring ten times too stiff behaves almost like a rigid support, one ten times too soft almost like no support; a slip of the decimal point or of the unit (kN/m against kN/mm) therefore redistributes reactions and moments.
